title: Workspace Indicator
tuckEnabledHint: Idle position hugs the bar's own edge instead of resting on its centerline; when it's also the outermost item in the first or last zone, tucks into that screen corner too
showIslandBackgroundHint: When not tucked, render the normal pill background behind it like any other atom
animateTransitionHint: When off, it stays permanently in its idle pose - hover has no effect
monitorsDescription: Choose which connected displays show the indicator. Leave every monitor on to show it everywhere.
